shared_elements: low-relief carved figures in strict profile
bearded/patterned hair and beard rendered in regular rows of curls
horizontal registers separated by plain bands
register of inscription-like or ornamental horizontal band
justification: Both show low-relief profile figures with meticulously patterned coiffures and beards, one arm raised holding an object, set within horizontal registers bounded by plain bands, and both include stylized rosette/floral motifs (a band of rosettes in B, a flowering plant field in A). The clearest difference is the subject: A features a single large bird-headed winged genius amid formal plants, whereas B shows a procession of ordinary human attendants with a horse and weapons, with no wings or animal head.
